question: What is the validity period and fee schedule for a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP)?
answer:
The validity period for a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP) is not explicitly stated in the provided sources. However, the fee schedule for a GP&EP can be found in [S2] and [S3].

From [S2]:
- For self-supporting trilon guyed structures up to 10.00 meters in height: Php 2,400.00 (fixed fee)
- For every meter or fraction thereof in excess of 10.00 meters: Php 120.00 per meter
- Accessory fees are not specified

From [S3]:
- Per cu.meter of excavation for renewal: Php 4.00
- Per sq. meter of structure: Php 38.00
- First 10-meter height: Php 2,400.00 (fixed fee)
- For more than 10 meters height (additional): Not explicitly stated in the provided sources

Please note that the fees mentioned are for the issuance of a GP&EP. The validity period might be determined during the application process or upon issuance of the permit. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, it is recommended to contact the Davao City Government or visit their official website.

Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin niini sa validity period ni GP&EP sa mga nakapag-aral sa aking database. Ang fee schedule ni GP&EP ay maaari nga makita sa [S2] at [S3].

Mula [S2]:
- Para sa mga trilon guyed na self-supporting up to 10.00 meters na kasaysayan: Php 2,400.00 (fixed fee)
- Para sa bawat meter o fraction na mas mataas sa 10.00 meters: Php 120.00 per meter
- Ang accessory fees ay hindi nakalagay sa mga nakapag-aral sa aking database

Mula [S3]:
- Per cu.meter ng excavation para sa renewal: Php 4.00
- Per sq. meter ng bahay: Php 38.00
- Ang unang 10-meter na kasaysayan: Php 2,400.00 (fixed fee)
- Para sa mas mataas pa sa 10 meters na kasaysayan (additional): Hindi nakalagay sa mga nakapag-aral sa aking database ang fee na ito.

Hindi lang ang mga fees ang nakalagay sa mga nakapag-aral sa aking database, ang validity period ay hindi rin nakalagay. Para sa pinaka-totoong at pinakamodernong impormasyon, maaari nga mag-contact ang mga taga-Davao City Government o mag-visit sa kanilang official website.

ground_truth: While the Building Permit is being processed, the Building Official may issue GP&EP for foundation subject to line-and-grade verification, inspection and review. It is valid only for 30 days or superseded upon Building Permit issuance. Fees: inspection/verification PHP200; excavation PHP3 per cubic meter; GP&EP issuance PHP50; foundation excavation with basement PHP4 per cubic meter; excavation other than foundation/basement PHP3 per cubic meter; permitted footing/foundation encroachment into public areas PHP250 per square meter or fraction thereof.
